title: micromeles needhamii
intro: Micromeles needhamii, commonly known as the Chinese box hawthorn or Needham's hawthorn, is a plant species native to China. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include improving cardiovascular health and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Micromeles needhamii include acting as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilator, which may contribute to its cardiovascular benefits. Bioactive constituents of Micromeles needhamii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
